macros.name: PredicateBoxRule
macros.doc: The macro \PredicateBoxRule contains the line thickness of box in the \Predicate command.

macros.name: PredicateBoxSep
macros.doc: The macro \PredicateBoxSep contains the amount of space between the box and contents in the \Predicate command.

macros.name: PredicateFileExtension
macros.doc: The macro \PredicateFileExtension contains the text appended to file name in the \Predicate command.

macros.name: PredicateFileFont
macros.doc: Macro containing the font changing command for the file name.

macros.name: PredicateFileSep
macros.doc: The macro \PredicateFileSep contains the width of the separating space between the predicate description and the file name.

macros.name: PredicateFileWidth
macros.doc: Macro containing the minimal width of the box containing the file name.

macros.name: PredicateFont
macros.doc: Macro containing the font changing command for the predicate description.

macros.name: PredicateIndent
macros.doc: Macro containing the maximal length of the indentation of the predicate description.

macros.name: PredicateIndex
macros.doc: The macro \PredicateIndex contains the command which is called to put a predicate into an index.

macros.name: PredicateSkip
macros.doc: Macro containing the spacing before and after the predicate description.

macros.name: PrologDialect
macros.doc: Declare the dialect of the used Prolog.

macros.name: PrologFile
macros.doc: The macro \PrologFile contains the command which is called at the beginning of a non-module Prolog file.

macros.name: PrologFont
macros.doc: The macro \PrologFont contains the font changing command executed to typeset the Prolog code in the verbatim-like environment.

macros.name: PrologIndent
macros.doc: The macro \PrologIndent contains the indentation of the Prolog code in the verbatim-like environment.

macros.name: PrologListFont
macros.doc: The macro \PrologListFont contains the font changing command to typeset a Prolog list (exports).

macros.name: PrologListIndent
macros.doc: The macro \PrologListIndent contains the indentation for a Prolog list (exports).

macros.name: PrologModule
macros.doc: The macro \PrologModule contains the command which is called at the beginning of a module.

macros.name: PrologNumberFont
macros.doc: The macro \PrologNumberFont contains the font changing command used to typeset the line numbers (if enabled) in the verbatim-like environment.

macros.name: PrologNumberLinesfalse
macros.doc: Turn off line numbering.

macros.name: PrologNumberLinestrue
macros.doc: Turn on line numbering.

macros.name: PrologRuleWidth
macros.doc: The macro \PrologRuleWidth contains the width of the rule separating Prolog code and text.

macros.name: WithUnderscore
macros.doc: The macro \WithUnderscore is provided by pl to execute some commands where the underscore does have the meaning of a plain character.
